integrationReview.reason: The service enforces user access and consent before job-tailoring workflows can operate on personal CV data.
integrationReview.contract: Authenticated user session and service-controlled access checks for CV, consent, and export state.
integrationReview.configuration: Auth integration is configured for the cv-tuning service boundary and consent gating.
integrationReview.failureMode: Access is denied and the workflow fails closed without processing personal CV data.
integrationReview.validation: User access and consent-specific checks pass in the service validation gate.

integrationReview.reason: The service keeps master CV data, application state, and consent metadata in durable relational storage.
integrationReview.contract: Persistent relational records for applications, renders, consent state, and export metadata.
integrationReview.configuration: Postgres database configuration and migrations for the cv-tuning domain tables.
integrationReview.failureMode: The service surfaces storage failure and prevents completion of uncommitted work.
integrationReview.validation: Database-backed lifecycle and persistence tests pass in the repo validation flow.

integrationReview.reason: Redis supports workflow coordination, temporary state, and cache behavior used by the service processing path.
integrationReview.contract: Short-lived cache and workflow handoff state for the application lifecycle.
integrationReview.configuration: Redis host and key-space configuration for the service runtime.
integrationReview.failureMode: Temporary degradation is surfaced without corrupting the underlying master state.
integrationReview.validation: Runtime validation confirms the service handles cache or workflow degradation safely.

integrationReview.reason: Runtime services emit structured logs for health, review, and operational analysis.
integrationReview.contract: POST to http://logging-microservice:3367 with service, level, msg, duration_ms, and timestamp fields.
integrationReview.configuration: Structured logging configuration through the shared logging service.
integrationReview.failureMode: The service keeps operating with degraded observability and surfaces the issue in logs.
integrationReview.validation: Structured log emission and monitoring checks are recorded in the validation evidence.

integrationReview.reason: The service sends outcome and reminder notifications as part of the application lifecycle and user follow-up flow.
integrationReview.contract: Authenticated delivery of application reminder and outcome notifications.
integrationReview.configuration: Notification channel configuration for the cv-tuning service.
integrationReview.failureMode: Notifications fail without blocking the user review and approval flow.
integrationReview.validation: Notification path is exercised and the resulting user message flow is observed.

integrationReview.reason: Core tailoring, claim grounding, and revision assistance all depend on the shared AI service.
integrationReview.contract: AI requests for job analysis, tailoring, and grounded review pass through the approved service boundary.
integrationReview.configuration: Model routing, prompt policy, and grounding validation configuration for cv-tuning.
integrationReview.failureMode: The service fails safely and does not present unsupported claims as valid output.
integrationReview.validation: Grounded generation and eval harness results are used as evidence in the task validation record.

integrationReview.reason: Project documentation must remain discoverable and traceable through the docs-RAG mechanism.

integrationReview.configuration: Repository catalog entry and project metadata in the shared ecosystem config.
integrationReview.failureMode: Git remains the authoritative source and retrieval failure does not override validated intent.
integrationReview.validation: Repository path resolution and document retrieval remain valid.

integrationReview.reason: Runtime health and readiness must be observable and traceable for the service.
integrationReview.contract: GET /health and Kubernetes probes for runtime readiness and health reporting.
integrationReview.configuration: Service health and readiness settings in the deployment metadata.
integrationReview.failureMode: Readiness blocks rollout until the service is healthy.
integrationReview.validation: Health and monitoring checks pass in the service validation path.

integrationReview.reason: The service stores personal career data and exported artifacts, so a clear backup posture is required for operational resilience.
integrationReview.contract: Backup and restore procedures for persisted user data and document assets.
integrationReview.configuration: Backup policy and retention configuration for the service persistent state.
integrationReview.failureMode: Service data protection errors are surfaced before broader public rollout.
integrationReview.validation: Backup posture is reviewed with deployment and operational readiness checks.
